content.title: I am a passionate and results-driven Full Stack Developer with a strong foundation in modern web technologies and a keen eye for intuitive design.
content.specialization: Specializing in React on the frontend and expanding my backend expertise—primarily with Node.js, along with C# and Microsoft Azure.
content.experience: With hands-on experience in tools like Tailwind CSS, styled-components, Framer Motion, Firebase, and Figma, I deliver both technical precision and visual appeal across the stack.
content.focus: My focus is on building scalable, maintainable, and innovative web applications that bridge frontend interactivity with robust backend systems.
content.goal: I strive to deliver complete solutions that are not only visually engaging but also technically sound, secure, and aligned with business goals.

experiences.description: As a Frontend Developer at Kan-guroo, I build dynamic, responsive web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I collaborate closely with designers to translate Figma prototypes into pixel-perfect interfaces, integrating animations with Framer Motion and interactive visuals with Canvas and Loopsie. I implement multilingual support with i18next and create seamless user experiences, including automated email workflows with EmailJS and scalable styling using Tailwind CSS.

As a Full Stack Developer at Delivo, I am responsible for the complete development lifecycle of both frontend and backend systems. I design, implement, and maintain robust, scalable web applications that enhance Delivo's logistics and business automation services. My key responsibilities include developing and integrating RESTful APIs, ensuring seamless communication between frontend and backend systems, and optimizing the overall architecture of the platform.

In my role as a Frontend Developer and 1C Support Specialist at Delivo, I work to automate and streamline critical business processes using the 1C platform. My focus is on enhancing package delivery systems by improving sender and receiver management, optimizing service center workflows, and upgrading transportation logistics. I collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate the frontend with backend systems effectively, ensuring seamless system operations. My contributions help create scalable, efficient, and user-friendly solutions that drive Delivo’s growth.

At Unilab, I was responsible for building and maintaining high-performance web applications using JavaScript and React.js. My work involved close collaboration with backend developers and UX/UI designers to integrate APIs, enhance user experience, and create visually dynamic user interfaces.

At AlgoUni, I studied the fundamentals of frontend development, focusing on creating responsive user interfaces and understanding the best practices in web development. I worked on several hands-on projects where I gained experience in React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. My coursework involved building reusable components, optimizing performance, and collaborating with team projects. This period was crucial in developing my foundational skills and understanding of frontend technologies.

descriptions.Telegram Courier Bot: Delivo courier delivery app integrated with Telegram Mini Apps. Built with React and TypeScript, it provides a seamless user experience with dynamic drag-and-drop order management, barcode scanning, and multilingual support. The app communicates with a custom backend using SQL for data storage and order tracking. It leverages the Telegram Web App SDK for smooth integration, while features like form handling, camera access, and responsive UI enhance usability inside Telegram.
descriptions.tik-tak-toe: A simple and interactive Tic Tac Toe game built with React. Features include a responsive game board, alternating turns between players, win detection logic, and a clean UI styled with styled-components. Perfect for practicing React fundamentals and game state management.
descriptions.Pomodoro App: A minimalistic and efficient Pomodoro app designed to boost productivity and focus. Features include customizable work and break intervals, progress tracking for completed cycles, and intuitive notifications to keep users on schedule.
descriptions.Dine restaurant website: A sophisticated restaurant website offering an elegant design and user-friendly experience. Features include seamless navigation, a responsive booking form, and integrated email functionality for reservations. Built with modern technologies for optimal performance and aesthetic appeal.
descriptions.Entertainment Web App: The Entertainment Web App allows you to choose your desired movies and series from a collection. Algorithms help users find content they are interested in quickly and easily. It also has a feature to save preferred content.
descriptions.E-commerce Product Page: Developed a dynamic e-commerce product page using Swiper JS and the Lightbox library. Implemented responsive image galleries and interactive product displays to enhance the user experience.
descriptions.Planet Fact Size: An interactive platform that offers a glimpse into the intriguing facts and sizes of planets in our solar system. Built using React, TypeScript, and Styled Components to create a seamless and visually appealing user experience.
descriptions.GitHub User Search App: A React TypeScript application designed to explore GitHub users and their repositories. Features a clean and intuitive interface for searching GitHub users and viewing detailed information.
descriptions.Store App: A fully functional e-commerce store built with vanilla JavaScript and SCSS. Features include dynamic product listings fetched from a public Store API, category filtering, product detail views, and an intuitive cart system. Styled with modern SCSS for a clean and responsive user interface.
descriptions.ToDo App: A web-based application to manage daily tasks efficiently. Users can add, complete, and remove tasks in a simple interface, developed using React, TypeScript, and Styled Components.
descriptions.Interactive Card Details Form: Created with React.js and Styled Components, this app allows users to fill and save card information, providing a dynamic and user-friendly interface.
descriptions.Tip Calculator: A React.js web app that calculates the tip amount and total per person based on the bill, tip percentage, and number of people.
descriptions.ExploreEra: A fully responsive web app created for the Unilab acceleration program in one week, showcasing exploration features with a sleek design.
descriptions.Countdown Timer: A fully responsive countdown timer for the New Year, built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, providing real-time updates with engaging animations.
